entities.name: Antonio María Fabié
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antonio María Fabié Escudero was a politician, writer, philosopher, historian, and bibliophile, noted for his Hegelian Philosophy which he became interested in during the mid-nineteenth century while a student at the University of Sevilla. He studied pharmacy, exact science, and law.
